the_one_changed_variable.effect: rl.py:2171 `if normalise_advantages and count > 1:` goes false, so :2172-2174 (std, subtract the mean, divide by sd + 1e-8) never run and adv_t is used exactly as GAE produced it.  ret_t (the critic's target, :2169-2170 / :2236) was never whitened in either config.
the_one_changed_variable.everything_else: copied value-for-value from the frozen 50k config; the unit test asserts the diff is exactly this key, the output naming (+ private data dir) and this advantage_norm_only block

terminal_block.note: a terminal reward only reaches PPO on a terminated transition, so both counters have to be > 0 for a training run to be about the task objective at all

actor_max_abs_parameter_change.quantity_compared: mean over updates of the per-update actor_max_abs_parameter_change, divided by 8 x actor_lr (the form the four published arms use)

death_penalty.counted: once per death, a first death does not end the episode

progress_total.unit: reward for traversing the whole first face by score
progress_total.counted: cumulative, hard-capped at progress_total per episode

progress_score_full.event: the score a real first-face clear reaches

survive_per_decision.unit: reward per decision at the two-frame beat
survive_per_decision.role: explicitly zero in r2; the bounded survival constant ε in r3
survive_per_decision.event: every decision the engine is alive
survive_per_decision.counted: r2: 0.0, because at γ = 0.999833 (τ = 200 s) the discounted sum of a constant c is c/(1-γ) ≈ 6001·c and a long stall would out-earn a clear.  r3: ε > 0 but bounded by the declared assertion ε·T_max ≤ 0.25·progress_total, which the config validator recomputes and refuses to load without

first_life_per_decision.unit: reward per decision the first life is alive
first_life_per_decision.event: every decision taken while globals.deaths == 0, i.e. before the first death; a decision on which the first death happens still pays, because the life was alive when the action was chosen
first_life_per_decision.counted: per decision, hard-capped per episode at first_life_cap; δ is derived from first_life_cap / the measured clear length (6598 decisions), so the cap is reached exactly at a clear

first_life_cap.event: never paid directly; it caps the first-life term

progress_bound.meaning: a trajectory can never earn more than progress_total from progress, however long it stalls

fail_closed_traceback.sentence: **落在带内。** 每更新 `actor_max_abs_parameter_change` 的均值是 **2.32378e-04**（除以 `8 × actor_lr` 得 0.968240），落在 `2.38e-4 ±5% = [2.2610e-04, 2.4990e-04]` 内。四臂实测带是 `[2.37984e-04, 2.40312e-04]`（即 `/8lr ∈ [0.9916, 1.0013]`），本臂落在它**之下**（相对其下沿 -2.36%），方向是**步幅略小**而不是略大。⇒ **P-N2 成立（按均值判），本实验不被追溯认定为学习率类修订**：白化没有在调步幅，§1.2「Adam 已把步幅与优势尺度解耦」的前提保住了；后续同类改动不因此受额外限制。

P_N1_quartile_falls_faster_than_r3_50k.reads: both legs failed: the quartile change is POSITIVE (first death improved during training) and the entropy mean is above 2.4945, so the 'common-mode reinjection' reading of spec 1.3 is falsified

P_N4_function.status: not_run: no forward comparison in this tier

criteria_outcome.rule_text: 主判据 fail ∧ 能力 0/40。**白化这一行不是这条差距的机制**（r3 配方、50k、单 seed 下）。三个候选里唯一零代码的那个被排除；N-a①/N-c 按 §1.2 被预测为 null；N-b 无良定义 ⇒ PPO 侧在本预算下的可调清单已经穷尽。
criteria_outcome.next_step: 只剩四条，都不是 PPO 系数：(a) 射击脉冲错配的量化与修复、(b) 3 seed × 1M（需另编预算）、(c) KL 判据修订后的 50k 复现、(d) 换观测/表征（2 帧节拍已被 H-a 证伪）。

mechanism_readings.reading: on this real rollout the r3 advantage is almost (epsilon + delta) x a purely temporal weight, so dropping the whitening mainly removes a 5.3303 sd common-mode ramp (and a constant 1/sd scale that Adam would absorb anyway)
mechanism_readings.caveat: measured on the audit slot (256 transitions, 1 segment, no episode termination), not on a training rollout; the training rollout's own advantage statistics were never recorded

limits: engine_truth reward and termination: a training-time privileged diagnostic, NOT R1
n=20 per ruler, point comparison, no interval; paired intervals are +/-220 / +/-400 frames
the boolean switches BOTH halves of the whitening (mean offset and /sd scale), so one run cannot separate them
training-rollout advantage statistics are still not recorded by the payload; the quoted advantage_sd is the audit-slot reading for the same recipe, and the whitening flag cannot change it
